Use this endpoint to match IP addresses based on [input values](#12a5c22b-cba1-4b40-a8c6-45f564cf0c2a) and return the desired [output fields](#ca8c2c2f-c731-4310-ae0d-dfba2fb756d7) in the response.

You can specify the output fields you want returned using the `outputFields` section in your request JSON (see the endpoint examples for syntax). If you do not specify output fields, all possible fields will be returned.

**Input params**

| Parameter | DataType | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
|
Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the [IP Enrich](#4421b337-3380-4bb0-8a0d-dbf8bac8a704) endpoint.
